conclusion: The selected customer keys support a complete exact source-local join for this requirement: all 13,155 communication customers match the 13,155 ERP SOLDTOPARTY values, with no ambiguous sales-document ownership observed.
limitations: Exact source-local key equality establishes this bounded join but is not a cross-system canonical identity publication.
Communication event identifiers are reused in the synthetic source, so only exact event duplicates were removed.
method: Read all 1,916,685 selected ERP line rows through the bound public DataRoom API, reduced them to 411,966 distinct SALESDOCUMENT records, and compared exact customer key sets against 56,545 exact-deduplicated communication events. Counted distinct endpoints and coverage, not row fanout.

conclusion: In the main 180-day comparison, 183 customers meet both conditions: fewer distinct sales documents and growth in at least one adverse component. Forty meet the transparent high-tier rule; 83 are complaint-led and 100 are delay-or-expedite-communication-led.
limitations: The delay-communication component is dominated by urgent expedite requests and is an operational-risk proxy, not proof that delivery was late.
No payment-reminder communication matched the explicit rules, and partial supporting-document coverage cannot prove absence.
The high tier is an explainable prioritization rule, not a probability.
method: Compared 2019-07-06 through 2020-01-01 with 2020-01-02 through 2020-06-29 at customer/distinct-sales-document grain. Classified communications with explicit regular expressions and separately tested observed late-shipment documents. The gate requires prior_orders > 0, recent_orders < prior_orders, and at least one adverse component increase.

conclusion: Only 38 of the 183 main-window customers also meet the rule in the 90-day sensitivity comparison; 11 of those 38 also meet the main-window high-tier rule. The 38-customer intersection is therefore the safer core watchlist, while the other 145 are a broader review pool.
limitations: Window stability does not validate future churn; it only shows that the descriptive rule recurs under a shorter horizon.
Retention is 20.765%, so the broad 183-customer pool is materially window-sensitive.
method: Repeated the same distinct-order and adverse-component rules on equal 90-day prior/recent windows ending at the same 2020-06-29 as-of date and intersected customer IDs with the 180-day result.
